events.did: shook her head and dug her nails into her palms, trying to see through the dream she was in
events.quote_anchor: June shook her head, trying to focus, to remember. It was just a dream. She needed to see through it.

events.did: got up from the diner table and headed for the door
events.quote_anchor: Instead, she got up from the table, heading for the door.

events.did: shed the shell and came back into her own body, feeling the ache of still-healing skin bloom in her side
events.quote_anchor: She took a deep breath and shed the shell. The moment she was back in her own body, pain bloomed dully in her side, the ache of still-healing skin

events.did: tried to breathe as his body buckled beneath him and he hit the ice
events.quote_anchor: He tried to breathe, but his lungs weren’t working right. His mouth was full of copper. And then his body was buckling beneath him

events.did: saw the frozen lake vanish and be replaced by a large white room somewhere inside EON
events.quote_anchor: Pain had shattered the illusion—amazing, how something so small could hurt so much—and the frozen lake was gone, replaced by a large white room, somewhere inside EON.

events.did: hauled herself up out of the icy water and onto the ice
events.quote_anchor: After several frantic moments, she finally managed to haul herself up, out of the water, and onto the ice.

events.did: pressed her hands against Mitch’s chest to try to staunch the blood
events.quote_anchor: she could do was press her hands against his chest, to try to staunch the blood, or maybe just to let him know that she was there

events.did: turned and saw a figure walking toward them across the lake, parting the fog behind Serena
events.quote_anchor: she turned in time to see a figure walking toward them, across the lake, parting the fog as they marched up behind Serena.

relations.did: Serena is Sydney’s sister, and the world darkens with Serena’s mood while the ice under Sydney cracks
relations.quote_anchor: She could feel the world around them darken with her sister’s mood. The fog thickened. The ice beneath her cracked.

relations.did: Sydney refuses to leave Mitch, saying he was there when her sister wasn’t and saved her when her sister didn’t
relations.quote_anchor: “I do!” Syd snapped, tears sliding down her cheeks. “He was there when you weren’t. He saved me when you didn’t.”

relations.did: Mitch told Sydney she was not alone, and Sydney thought he meant he would be with her till the end
relations.quote_anchor: And for a second, Sydney thought he meant, she wasn’t alone. That he was with her. Would be, till the end.

relations.did: Serena’s gun was real and the bullet in Mitch’s chest was real
relations.quote_anchor: But the gun in Serena’s hand was real.

numbers.did: the picture it made of Sydney and Abigail overlaid like red and blue: 3D (原文: 3D)
numbers.quote_anchor: The two sat there, superimposed, overlaid like red and blue to make a 3D picture.

numbers.did: how many options she had for getting out of the dream: only one (原文: one)
numbers.quote_anchor: There was only one option, and June really, really didn’t want to do it.

numbers.did: how many frantic moments it took her to climb out of the water: several (原文: several)
numbers.quote_anchor: After several frantic moments, she finally managed to haul herself up, out of the water, and onto the ice.

numbers.did: how long she thought Mitch meant she wasn’t alone: for a second (原文: a second)
numbers.quote_anchor: And for a second, Sydney thought he meant, she wasn’t alone.
